title: Playful captures player or compatible actor without collision

verification.actor: One prepared WILD Clefairy (species 35) as the Playful subject and one prepared WILD Clefable (species 36) as a compatible actor target, both current and presentation-attached.
verification.trigger: Run one idle-boundary case with only Clefable visible, then move the player into Vision for the later player-target case; keep the selected target stationary until Clefairy stops at its non-collision boundary.
verification.observable: Requirement current.playful-target-and-collision: condition-playful-notices-compatible-actor captures the nearest compatible Clefable when the player case is false, and condition-playful-notices-player captures PLAYER when its later entry is active. In both cases Clefairy approaches or circles the captured target, completes motion, and never commits onto the target's occupied tile.

setupMutations.change: Use one disposable test.sav with checked teleport, native Clefairy and Clefable spawns, exact binds, and a clear lane with the player initially outside Vision. Do not patch condition state, profile values, collision results, target selection, timers, or movement.

limits: The bound runtime observer retains both authored target entries, complete motions, commits, and control returns. Its copied-data controls reject missing subject and missing feature evidence.
Both conditions use the playful-pokemon subject pool, current Vision, 420-frame duration, 430-frame cooldown, and 100 percent chance. The player condition is last and wins when both are active.
Prepared spawn and placement do not prove natural population selection or every compatible actor species.

events.value: Bind current Clefairy and compatible Clefable in the actor-target arrangement with the player outside Clefairy's Vision.
Observe compatible-actor capture, Playful approach or circle motion, target-tile rejection, terminal commit, and control return.
Start the separate player-target arrangement with the same species and authored profile contract.
Observe player capture, Playful approach or circle motion, player-tile rejection, terminal commit, and control return.

stop.condition: Both target kinds are captured in their declared case and both complete without occupying the selected target tile.

invariants: Each condition captures at most one current target
The compatible-actor case captures Clefable and the player case captures PLAYER
The player entry wins when both Playful entries are active
Clefairy never commits onto the captured actor or player tile
